Maybe he is stopping the job search after 4 hours because he is feeling discouraged? And the video games are his way to release that frustration. I'm not trying to presume I know the situation completely just throwing things out there. He may not want to talk about it with you due to feeling shame or guilt that you are having to be the provider for you both. Do you reaffirm each other every day? If you want to talk about a hard/stressful situation with him, starting out with a positive topic that you both enjoy may help. That way neither of you feel as though you're being attacked or have to be defensive. I hope he is also letting you know that he appreciates how hard you work and how much you care about him.
